design.name: 冰灯鬼火
design.brief: A floating ghost lantern of the abbey, the kamikaze: a round red-paper Chinese lantern frozen stiff, cracked and patched, with a grinning ghost face torn into its paper, a cold jade-green ghost flame burning inside (weak spot: the whole lantern), icicles hanging from its bottom rim and a frayed tassel, two little tattered paper arms. It drifts and swoops at the player, then bursts into a freezing cloud. Mischievous.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, paper and cloth as thick simple bands, fur as big carved clumps.
